Changes since [1.4.2](https://github.com/ops-software/mini-oled-dock/releases/tag/v1.4.2): a check before the dock switches the Windows taskbar to auto-hide. Thanks to Ragnatela666 for the fix.

### Fixes

- **Fewer "there is already an auto-hide toolbar" messages.** Some users saw a Windows message titled "Taskbar" saying there is already an auto-hide toolbar on this side of the screen, usually right after a full-screen game started. The dock hides the Windows taskbar by switching it to auto-hide, and Windows allows only one auto-hide bar per screen edge. Before switching auto-hide on, the dock now checks whether another program's bar already holds that edge. If one does, the dock leaves the setting alone instead of triggering the message. The taskbar stays hidden either way, but Windows may keep a strip at the bottom of the screen free until the taskbar is shown again. We could not reproduce the original problem, so this may not remove the message in every case. The dock now records these decisions in its log (`dock.log` in `C:\ProgramData\mini-oled-dock`). If the message still appears, please send us that file together with a screenshot of the message.

### Install / update

Requires Windows 11. **On 1.4.0 or 1.4.1, install this release by hand once:** their updater cannot fetch it. Download `dock.exe` and run it from a terminal:

```powershell
.\dock.exe --install
```

It asks for administrator rights, replaces the installed dock and restarts it. Settings are kept. From 1.4.2 on, **Settings → Updates → Update now** installs this release by itself.
